Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.

criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of perceptrons and mlp.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report gradient error and held-out task accuracy against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for mistaking memorization for generalization; detect it or rule it out with evidence.
